Story of Seasons is the latest Harvest Moon title and allows players to fully create their own character from scratch. XSEED will be bringing the game to North America in 2014.

Return to PopoloCrois: A Story of Seasons Fairytale

The fairy tale world of PoPoLoCrois meets the farm living of Story of Seasons in this cross-over RPG. It features classically-styled turn-based combat and towns full of lively and interesting NPCs who contribute to a heartwarming narrative that veterans or newcomers to either franchise can enjoy. Ample farming and life simulation elements such as crop-raising, bug-catching, rock quarrying, item synthesis and more round out the experience.

El mundo de cuento de hadas de PoPoLoCrois se encuentra con la vida campestre de Story of Seasons en este RPG crossover. Incluye combates por turnos de estilo clásico y pueblos llenos de personajes no jugables vivaces e interesantes que aportan a una narrativa entrañable, la cual pueden disfrutar tanto los veteranos como los recién llegados a cualquiera de las dos franquicias. Abundantes elementos de simulación agrícola y de vida, como el cultivo de cosechas, la captura de insectos, la extracción de rocas, la síntesis de objetos y más, completan la experiencia.

Story of Seasons: Trio of Towns

The series is celebrating its 20th anniversary with a new game for the Nintendo 3DS. The title of the game is Bokujō Monogatari: Mitsu no Sato no Taisetsu na Tomodachi (Harvest Moon/Story of Seasons: Precious Friends From Three Villages).

The game will have at least three locales: Lulucoco Town, Tsuyukusa Village and Wes Town. The culture of each will be completely different. Lulucoco is an island settlement, Tsuyukusa is a Japanese village, and Wes Town is a western-style town.

The game will feature a protagonist - female or male - and the characters Noel, Miranda, Megan, and Frank from Wes Town.

La saga celebra su 20.º aniversario con un nuevo juego para Nintendo 3DS. El título del juego es Bokujō Monogatari: Mitsu no Sato no Taisetsu na Tomodachi (Harvest Moon/Story of Seasons: Precious Friends From Three Villages).

El juego tendrá al menos tres localidades: Lulucoco Town, Tsuyukusa Village y Wes Town. La cultura de cada una será completamente diferente. Lulucoco es un asentamiento isleño, Tsuyukusa es una aldea japonesa y Wes Town es un pueblo de estilo occidental.

El juego contará con un protagonista (femenino o masculino) y con los personajes Noel, Miranda, Megan y Frank, de Wes Town.

Story of Seasons: Pioneers of Olive Town

The long-awaited brand new entry in the original farm/life simulation franchise, known in Japan as Bokujo Monogatari, makes its debut on Nintendo Switch, bringing players more freedom than ever before to shape an untamed wilderness and customize their farm down to the very tile. A new cast of marriage candidates, a town that grows and thrives along with your farm, and a request system highlight the new features, all while retaining the core elements of the STORY OF SEASONS series. Finding Earth Sprites while exploring your farmland may lead you to mysterious, fantastical lands such as gardens where the seasons never change, an island in the sky, or even the inside of a volcano!

La tan esperada nueva entrega de la franquicia original de simulación agrícola y de vida, conocida en Japón como Bokujō Monogatari, debuta en Nintendo Switch y ofrece a los jugadores más libertad que nunca para moldear una tierra salvaje y personalizar su granja hasta la última casilla. Un nuevo elenco de candidatos a matrimonio, un pueblo que crece y prospera junto con tu granja y un sistema de encargos destacan entre las novedades, todo ello conservando los elementos básicos de la serie STORY OF SEASONS. Al explorar tus tierras, encontrar Espíritus de la Tierra puede llevarte a lugares misteriosos y fantásticos, como jardines donde las estaciones nunca cambian, una isla en el cielo o ¡incluso el interior de un volcán!
